text:
Lena Morales: quick update from vendor sync — H100 fw candidate shows non-deterministic tail spikes under large-batch attention (>2048 tokens). we need to lock marketplace messaging and partner handoffs.
Hector Alvarez: is this a correctness bug or perf edge?
Zoe Kim: vendor says perf only (tail-latency). they can ship a mitigations bundle but it might slip the announce window.
Marcus Lee: rough plan suggestion: promote Gaudi GA first, label H100 as 'pilot' behind a partner-facing tile, and make H200 the fallback SKU in the public marketplace.
Lena Morales: agree. we should also include a clear partner pre-brief with rollback criteria and a canned routing policy. SI partners want a client patch for H200 memory layout changes.
VendorBot: Vendor note posted: https://partners.redwood.ai/notes/PRJ-9021 — H100 fw delay estimated 7d. :warning:
Hector Alvarez: inventory check: H200 capacity is constrained in eu-west for next two weeks. we can direct eu customers to Gaudi or B200.
Zoe Kim: propose rollout windows (initial draft):
- Wave 1 (04/29): gaudi:stable + b200:economy (public)
- Wave 2 (05/08): h200:recommended + h100:pilot (partner-only) if fw mitigation validated
- MI300: keep preview flag until driver 1.4 clears JIT hang fixes
Marcus Lee: good. add a note for SIs: 72h heads-up required before any promote and provide a sample rdw-sdk patch.
Lena Morales: sample routing policy snippet for partners:
```
primary: model=h100 tag=pilot-20240508
fallback: model=h200 tag=stable
degrade: model=b200 tier=economy
region_fallback: eu-west->gaudi:stable
```
Hector Alvarez: add rollback triggers: p99 latency > 2.5x baseline OR sustained error rate > 0.4% over 15m -> immediate traffic reroute. also monitor kv-cache miss delta > 12%.
Zoe Kim: canaries planned: latency_p99, kv_cache_warmup, mem_layout_smoke, quant_consistency. I'll post manifests to the runbook.
Marcus Lee: I'll run H200 fallback smoke on staging-cluster-a and staging-cluster-b tomorrow morning.
VendorBot: SI partners requested: a 72h window + a minimal migration guide for client libs.
Lena Morales: action items recap:
- Zoe: upload canary manifests + run canaries (ETA 04/24)
- Marcus: H200 smoke runs + logs (ETA 04/24 AM)
- Hector: region capacity map + recommended regional SKUs (ETA 04/23)
- Lena: draft partner pre-brief and press contingency blurb (ETA EOD 04/23)
Zoe Kim: canary manifest example uploaded:
```
image: registry.redwood.ai/h200:2024-04-24-canary
tests:
  - latency_p99
  - kv_cache_warmup
  - mem_layout_smoke
  - quant_consistency
```
Marcus Lee: kicked off H200 smoke: cluster-a job 11345 started. will share logs.
Ops Bot: Canary job 11345 queued. will notify on completion.
Hector Alvarez: small supply note: if H200 runs tight in eu-west we'll flag the marketplace tile with "limited capacity" and include regional fallback routing.
Zoe Kim: canary results: gaudi green 5/5, h200 smoke 3/4 (quant_consistency failed on a 8-bit MLP path). ticket opened with vendor (VID-221).
Lena Morales: given that, proceed with Wave 1 (Gaudi + B200). hold Wave 2 approval until quant fix and H100 mitigation validated.
VendorBot: Vendor ops call scheduled: 04/30 09:00 — FW mitigation review. :calendar:
Marcus Lee: i'll prepare a 2-bullet contingency note for comms: (1) technical regression -> staggered availability, (2) supply constraints -> regional phased availability.
Zoe Kim: uploaded partner brief draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/partnerships/partner-brief-0424 — includes rollback rules, routing examples, and SDK patch link.
Hector Alvarez: adding regional SKU mapping to the doc now.
Lena Morales: thanks all. final: i'll loop in Comms + Legal on 04/27 internal signoff once canaries show green. closing thread unless vendor updates ETA.
